items.title: Virtual Reality-assisted Physiotherapeutic Training for Patients With Knee Osteoarthritis: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 5 RCTs found that VR-assisted physiotherapy significantly improved pain (SMD = 0.40, 95% CI: 0.14-0.65, P = 0.002), physical function (SMD = 0.37, 95% CI: 0.05-0.70, P = 0.003), and balance (SMD = 0.44, 95% CI: 0.16-0.72, P = 0.002) in patients with knee osteoarthritis compared to traditional rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: VR 辅助康复在缓解膝关节骨性关节炎疼痛、改善功能和平衡方面有显著效果，效应量中等。可以考虑将其纳入患者康复方案，作为传统治疗的有效补充。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实辅助物理治疗对膝骨关节炎患者的效果：系统综述与 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 5 项随机对照试验的系统综述和 Meta 分析显示，与传统康复治疗相比，VR 辅助物理治疗能显著改善膝骨关节炎患者的疼痛 (SMD = 0.40)、身体功能 (SMD = 0.37) 和平衡 (SMD = 0.44)。
items.curatedReasonEn: VR-assisted physiotherapy significantly improves pain, physical function, and balance in knee osteoarthritis patients with moderate effect sizes. Consider integrating it into rehabilitation programs as an effective adjunct to traditional treatments.
items.limitation: 本系统综述仅纳入 5 项 RCT，研究数量和样本量仍偏小，长期效果有待更多大样本研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included only 5 RCTs, indicating a relatively small number of studies and sample size. Long-term effects require further validation through larger studies.

items.title: Chemical Neurolysis May Provide Long-Lasting Pain Relief in AVN-Related Hip Pain: Study Shows
items.summary: A recent study suggests that chemical neurolysis targeting anterior hip capsular branches may provide long-lasting pain relief for up to six months in patients with avascular necrosis (AVN)-related hip pain.
items.curatedReason: 化学神经溶解术对髋关节股骨头坏死（AVN）相关疼痛可能提供长达 6 个月的缓解。虽然这不是 PT 直接干预，但你可以将其视为保守治疗无效后的转诊选项。
items.titleZh: 研究显示：化学神经溶解术可为股骨头坏死相关髋痛提供长期缓解
items.summaryZh: 一项最新研究表明，针对髋关节前方囊支的化学神经溶解术，可能为股骨头坏死（AVN）相关的髋关节疼痛患者提供长达六个月的持续缓解。
items.curatedReasonEn: Chemical neurolysis may offer up to 6 months of pain relief for AVN-related hip pain. While not a direct PT intervention, you can consider this as a referral option when conservative treatments are ineffective.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的技术报告，可能样本量较小，需更大型研究验证其长期有效性和安全性。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary technical report, likely with a small sample size, and larger studies are needed to validate its long-term efficacy and safety.

items.title: Post-traumatic dental care, mouthguard use, and preventive behaviour among athletes participating in sports with different contact intensities: a cross-sectional study | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A cross-sectional study investigated post-traumatic dental care, mouthguard use, and preventive behaviors among athletes in sports with different contact intensities.
items.curatedReason: 牙外伤在竞技体育中并不少见。这项研究提示，不同接触强度运动的运动员在创伤后牙科护理和护齿器使用上存在差异。尽管是牙科研究，但它提醒我们在运动康复中，应把运动员的口腔健康与全身防护一并考虑，别漏掉这个细节。
items.titleZh: 不同接触强度运动中运动员创伤后牙科护理、护齿器使用及预防行为：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究调查了参与不同接触强度运动的运动员在创伤后牙科护理、护齿器使用和预防行为方面的状况。
items.curatedReasonEn: Dental trauma is common in competitive sports. This study suggests athletes in sports with varying contact intensities differ in post-traumatic dental care and mouthguard use. While a dental study, it reminds us to integrate oral health into comprehensive athlete protection during sports rehabilitation; don't overlook this detail.
items.limitation: 作为一项横断面观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且依赖自我报告数据。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional observational study, it cannot establish causality and relies on self-reported data.

items.title: Serum metabolomic profiling of exercise response and hyperuricemia status in athletes: a two-part exploratory study | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A two-part exploratory study conducted serum metabolomic profiling to analyze exercise response and hyperuricemia status in athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究通过血清代谢组学分析运动员的运动反应和高尿酸血症状态，为理解运动生理学提供了潜在的新生物标志物。你未来在评估运动员代谢健康时可能会用到。
items.titleZh: 运动员运动反应及高尿酸血症状态的血清代谢组学分析：一项两阶段探索性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段探索性研究对运动员的血清代谢组进行了分析，以了解运动反应和高尿酸血症状态。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study, by analyzing athletes' serum metabolomic profiles, suggests potential new biomarkers for exercise response and hyperuricemia. While still in early stages, keep an eye on these indicators for their future potential in assessing athlete metabolic health.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性研究，样本量和研究设计可能限制了结论的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: As an exploratory study, sample size and study design might limit the generalizability of the conclusions.

items.title: AOT study protocol of a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial protocol explores whether a pathological model can improve the abilities of the paretic hand in hemiplegic children.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对偏瘫儿童手功能改善的随机对照试验方案，有望验证“病理模型”训练策略的有效性。它可能为你的儿童神经康复，特别是上肢功能训练，带来新的干预框架。
items.titleZh: 病理模型能否改善偏瘫儿童患侧手功能？PAM-AOT 随机对照试验方案
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验方案旨在探讨病理模型训练能否改善偏瘫儿童患侧手的功能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial protocol on improving paretic hand abilities in hemiplegic children aims to validate a "pathological model" training strategy. It could offer a new intervention framework for your pediatric neurorehabilitation, especially for upper limb function.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未报告最终结果。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and final results have not yet been reported.

items.title: CMS News: CMS Announces Nationwide Expansion of Proven Joint Replacement Program
items.summary: CMS is expanding its bundled payment program for hip and knee replacements nationwide, impacting reimbursement and care delivery models for physical therapy providers.
items.curatedReason: CMS 将全国推广髋膝关节置换捆绑支付项目，这意味着更多 PT 诊所和医院将直接参与这种支付模式。需要熟悉新规，优化术后康复路径，确保绩效。
items.titleZh: CMS 宣布在全国范围内推广成熟的关节置换项目
items.summaryZh: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心 (CMS) 宣布，将在全国范围内推广成熟的关节置换捆绑支付项目，这将影响物理治疗提供者的报销和护理提供模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS is expanding its bundled payment program for hip and knee replacements nationwide. This means more PT clinics and hospitals will directly engage with this payment model. Familiarize yourself with the new rules to optimize post-operative rehab pathways and ensure performance.

items.title: FY 2027 Hospital Inpatient Prospective Payment System and Long-Term Care Hospital Prospective Payment System Final Rule (CMS-1849-F)
items.summary: The CMS FY 2027 Final Rule for Hospital Inpatient Prospective Payment System and Long-Term Care Hospital Prospective Payment System outlines updated payment policies for these facilities.
items.curatedReason: 新规虽未直接调整 PT 报销，但住院和长期护理医院的整体支付框架变动，会直接影响你所在机构的运营和资源分配。你需要关注这些变化，以便理解医院战略调整的底层逻辑。
items.titleZh: 2027 财年医院住院预付费系统和长期护理医院预付费系统最终规则（CMS-1849-F）
items.summaryZh: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心 (CMS) 发布了 2027 财年医院住院预付费系统和长期护理医院预付费系统的最终规则，阐述了针对这些机构的最新支付政策。
items.curatedReasonEn: This CMS final rule doesn't directly alter PT reimbursement, but changes to hospital inpatient and long-term care hospital payment systems directly impact your facility's operations and resource allocation. You need to understand these shifts to grasp the underlying logic of your institution's strategic adjustments.

items.title: One-year Health Care Utilization Following Physical Therapist Evaluation in a Veterans Affairs Emergency Department.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study found that physical therapist evaluation in a Veterans Affairs Emergency Department was associated with increased 1-year physical therapist visit utilization but did not significantly change overall musculoskeletal healthcare utilization compared to traditional ED care.
items.curatedReason: 急诊物理治疗师干预，对患者一年内总肌骨医疗利用率和后续 PT 就诊率的影响有待更多研究。本研究提示，相比传统急诊，有 PT 介入的急诊可能不会显著减少一年内整体肌骨医疗支出，但可以提高 PT 的利用率。
items.titleZh: 退伍军人事务部急诊物理治疗师评估后一年的医疗服务利用情况
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究显示，在退伍军人事务部急诊接受物理治疗师评估的患者，其一年内物理治疗就诊率有所增加，但与传统急诊护理相比，整体肌骨医疗服务利用率并未显著改变。
items.curatedReasonEn: The impact of ED PT intervention on one-year musculoskeletal healthcare utilization and subsequent PT visits needs further investigation. This study suggests that ED PT may not significantly reduce overall musculoskeletal healthcare costs in the long term compared to traditional ED care, but it could increase PT utilization.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，且仅限于单一 VA 医疗系统的退伍军人，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort study limited to veterans within a single VA healthcare system, which limits the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Understanding barriers and motivators for fruit and vegetable intake in female stroke survivors: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored barriers and motivators to fruit and vegetable intake in ten female stroke survivors, identifying themes such as feeling "Navigating alone" for dietary support and a willingness to improve intake "If it's good for me."
items.curatedReason: 定性研究揭示了女性卒中幸存者在蔬果摄入方面的障碍和驱动因素，特别是对营养支持的孤独感。在康复计划中，您应更主动地评估并提供个性化的饮食支持和教育，这可能有助于改善患者的整体健康。
items.titleZh: 了解女性卒中幸存者蔬果摄入障碍与驱动因素：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了十名女性卒中幸存者蔬果摄入的障碍与驱动因素，揭示了她们在饮食支持方面感到“独自摸索”以及在“如果对我有益”的前提下愿意改善摄入。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals barriers and motivators for fruit and vegetable intake in female stroke survivors, particularly their feelings of isolation regarding nutritional support. In your rehabilitation programs, you should proactively assess and provide personalized dietary support and education, which could contribute to improving patients' overall well-being.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小且仅针对女性卒中幸存者，结果不具普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size focused solely on female stroke survivors, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: A systematic review of current evidence on clinical outcomes of lumbar roll and modified SIMS manipulation techniques in sacroiliac joint dysfunction.
items.summary: This systematic review evaluated clinical outcomes of lumbar roll and modified SIMS manipulation techniques for sacroiliac joint dysfunction (SIJD), searching studies published between January 2021 and December 2025.
items.curatedReason: 对于骶髂关节功能障碍，这份系统综述评估了腰骶部滚动和改良 SIMS 手法的临床效果。目前来看，选择这两种手法时，你仍需仔细权衡其有效性，证据强度尚未达到可以给出明确推荐的程度。
items.titleZh: 关于腰骶部滚动手法和改良 SIMS 手法治疗骶髂关节功能障碍临床疗效的最新证据系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述评估了 2021 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月期间发表的关于腰骶部滚动手法和改良 SIMS 手法治疗骶髂关节功能障碍（SIJD）的临床疗效。
items.curatedReasonEn: Regarding sacroiliac joint dysfunction, this systematic review evaluates the clinical outcomes of lumbar roll and modified SIMS manipulation. Currently, when choosing these two techniques, you still need to carefully weigh their effectiveness, as the evidence strength is not yet sufficient to provide clear recommendations.
items.limitation: 本系统综述的纳入研究可能存在异质性，需要评估其对整体结论的潜在影响。
items.limitationEn: Included studies in this systematic review may exhibit heterogeneity, requiring evaluation of its potential impact on overall conclusions.

items.title: Characteristics and Specific Aspects of the Therapeutic Alliance in Physiotherapy Care: A Qualitative Study in France.
items.summary: This qualitative study in France identifies and describes the characteristics of the therapeutic alliance in French physiotherapy, highlighting the unique relational dynamics created by touch and physical activity.
items.curatedReason: 理解治疗联盟的独特性，有助于你在法国（或类似文化背景）的物理治疗实践中更好地与患者建立关系，提升康复效果。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗照护中治疗联盟的特点与特定方面：一项法国定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项法国定性研究识别并描述了法国物理治疗中治疗联盟的特点，强调了触摸和身体活动所产生的独特关系动态。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding the unique aspects of the therapeutic alliance can help you better build relationships with patients in French (or similar cultural) physiotherapy practice, thereby improving rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，其发现描述了特定文化背景下的独特关系动态，因此外推至其他文化环境需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study describing unique relational dynamics within a specific cultural context; thus, generalization to other cultural environments should be done with caution.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Weight Bearing Decisions After Tibial Plateau Fractures: A Literature Review Based on Clinical Perspective for Physiotherapists in India.
items.summary: This literature review provides a practical, physiotherapist-applicable framework for weight-bearing decision-making after tibial plateau fractures in India, addressing the lack of India-specific guidance and the conflation of early mobilization with early weight bearing.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床视角的文献综述为印度物理治疗师处理胫骨平台骨折患者的负重决策提供了实用框架，填补了当地指南空白。
items.titleZh: 胫骨平台骨折后的负重决策：基于印度物理治疗师临床视角的文献综述
items.summaryZh: 这份文献综述为印度物理治疗师提供了胫骨平台骨折后负重决策的实用框架，旨在解决当地缺乏特异性指南以及早期活动与早期负重混淆的问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical perspective literature review offers a practical framework for weight-bearing decisions in tibial plateau fracture patients for Indian physiotherapists, addressing a gap in local guidelines.
items.limitation: 本综述是基于印度本土文献和临床视角，其结论对外推至其他医疗系统需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This review is based on Indian literature and clinical perspectives, so its conclusions should be applied with caution to other healthcare systems.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Cost-effectiveness of stratified physiotherapy integrated with digital health versus usual physiotherapy for neck and/or shoulder pain: results of a cluster randomised clinical trial.
items.summary: A Stratified Blended Physiotherapy Approach (SBPA) combining prognostic risk stratification with digital health demonstrated cost-effectiveness compared to usual physiotherapy for patients with neck and/or shoulder pain in a cluster randomized clinical trial of 139 patients.
items.curatedReason: 分层融合物理治疗（结合预后风险分层和数字健康）在颈肩痛的成本效益上优于常规物理治疗。这意味着在管理颈肩痛患者时，结合数字工具的分层方法能带来更好的经济效益。
items.titleZh: 分层融合物理治疗结合数字健康与常规物理治疗治疗颈肩痛的成本效益：一项整群随机临床试验结果。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 139 名颈肩痛患者的整群随机临床试验显示，结合预后风险分层和数字健康的分层融合物理治疗（SBPA）与常规物理治疗相比，在成本效益方面表现更优。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stratified Blended Physiotherapy Approach (SBPA), integrating prognostic risk stratification with digital health, is more cost-effective than usual physiotherapy for neck and shoulder pain. This means a stratified approach with digital tools offers better economic value in managing these patients.
items.limitation: 研究未明确报告具体患者依从性或技术使用率对成本效益的影响。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly report the impact of specific patient adherence or technology utilization on cost-effectiveness.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effectiveness of an individualised swimming and education programme for chronic low back pain (EduSwim): a randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: An individualized swimming and education program delivered via telehealth over 8 weeks was more effective than education alone in improving disability for adults with chronic non-specific low back pain in a randomized controlled trial.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性下腰痛，8 周的个性化游泳和教育项目，虽然优于单纯教育，但效应量未明确报道，提示其改善残疾的临床意义仍需更多数据支持。继续将游泳作为多模式治疗方案的选项之一，但别过度宣传。
items.titleZh: 个性化游泳与教育项目治疗慢性下腰痛的有效性（EduSwim）：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，针对慢性非特异性下腰痛患者，为期 8 周、通过远程物理治疗提供的个性化游泳与教育项目，在改善残疾方面优于单纯教育。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic low back pain, an 8-week individualized swimming and education program was superior to education alone, but the effect size was not explicitly reported, suggesting that its clinical significance in improving disability requires further data. Continue to consider swimming as an option in multimodal treatment, but avoid overstating its benefits.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了 8 周短期效果，长期随访数据缺失。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed short-term effects at 8 weeks, lacking long-term follow-up data.

items.title: The RESOLVE Trial: A Stepped-Wedge, Cluster-Randomized Clinical Trial Evaluating the Effects of Clinical Practice Guidelines and Psychologically Informed Physical Therapy on Low Back Pain Outcomes in Service Members and Veterans.
items.summary: A stepped-wedge, cluster-randomized trial demonstrated that implementing clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) combined with psychologically informed physical therapy (PIPT) reduced low back pain-related disability and pain in service members and veterans.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，将临床实践指南（CPGs）与心理知情物理治疗（PIPT）相结合能有效改善服务人员和退伍军人的下腰痛结局。这强化了我们对综合性、多维度治疗方法的理解，特别是在退伍军人这一特定人群中。
items.titleZh: RESOLVE 试验：一项分阶段整群随机临床试验，评估临床实践指南和心理知情物理治疗对服务人员和退伍军人下腰痛结局的影响。
items.summaryZh: 一项分阶段整群随机试验显示，在军事和退伍军人医疗环境中，结合临床实践指南（CPGs）和心理知情物理治疗（PIPT）的实施策略，能有效减轻下腰痛相关的残疾和疼痛。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that implementing clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) combined with psychologically informed physical therapy (PIPT) effectively improves low back pain outcomes in service members and veterans. This reinforces our understanding of integrated, multi-dimensional treatment approaches, especially in this specific population.
items.limitation: 研究的 stepped-wedge 设计可能引入时间效应偏差，且结果主要适用于军事和退伍军人医疗环境。
items.limitationEn: The stepped-wedge design of the study may introduce time-effect bias, and results are primarily applicable to military and veteran healthcare settings.

items.title: Positive Psychology Interventions for Adults with Spinal Cord Injury: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 8 interventional studies found that positive psychology interventions (PPIs) aligning with Seligman's PERMA model effectively improved health and wellbeing outcomes in adults with spinal cord injury (SCI).
items.curatedReason: 积极心理学干预（PPIs）能有效改善脊髓损伤（SCI）成年患者的健康和福祉结局。在 SCI 康复中，除了身体功能训练，我们应开始更系统地整合心理支持，尤其是那些基于 PERMA 模型的干预措施。
items.titleZh: 积极心理学干预对脊髓损伤成年患者的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 8 项干预研究的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，符合 Seligman PERMA 模型的积极心理学干预（PPIs）能有效改善脊髓损伤（SCI）成年患者的健康和福祉结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: Positive psychology interventions (PPIs) effectively improve health and wellbeing outcomes in adults with spinal cord injury (SCI). Beyond just physical function training, we should begin to systematically integrate psychological support, particularly PERMA model-based interventions, into SCI rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 纳入的研究数量有限（8 项），且研究设计可能存在异质性，影响荟萃分析的整体强度。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies (8) and potential heterogeneity in study designs may affect the overall strength of the meta-analysis.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Joint Associations of Sleep-Disordered Breathing and Cerebral Small Vessel Disease Burden With Executive Performance, Balance, and In-Hospital Falls in Patients With Subacute Supratentorial Ischemic Stroke Undergoing Inpatient Rehabilitation.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 1,050 adults with subacute supratentorial ischemic stroke found that sleep-disordered breathing and cerebral small vessel disease burden were jointly associated with lower executive performance, impaired balance, and higher incidence of in-hospital falls.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究强调了睡眠呼吸障碍和脑小血管疾病负担与亚急性幕上缺血性卒中患者执行功能、平衡及住院跌倒之间的关联。这提示你在评估卒中患者时，需关注这些合并症对康复结局的潜在影响。
items.titleZh: 睡眠呼吸障碍和脑小血管疾病负担与亚急性幕上缺血性卒中患者执行功能、平衡及住院跌倒的联合关联。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 1050 名亚急性幕上缺血性卒中患者的回顾性队列研究发现，睡眠呼吸障碍和脑小血管疾病负担与较低的执行功能、平衡障碍以及较高的住院跌倒发生率存在联合关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study highlights the association between sleep-disordered breathing and cerebral small vessel disease burden with executive performance, balance, and in-hospital falls in patients with subacute supratentorial ischemic stroke. This suggests that when evaluating stroke patients, you should consider the potential impact of these comorbidities on rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 回顾性队列研究设计无法建立因果关系，且结果可能受未测量混杂因素影响。
items.limitationEn: The retrospective cohort study design cannot establish causality, and results may be influenced by unmeasured confounding factors.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Post-discharge kinesiophobia trajectories and rehabilitation outcomes in post-stroke hemiplegia.
items.summary: A single-center prospective longitudinal study of 296 patients with post-stroke hemiplegia identified 6-month kinesiophobia trajectories and found associations with motor recovery and rehabilitation exercise adherence.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性研究揭示了卒中后偏瘫患者出院后的运动恐惧（kinesiophobia）轨迹，并发现其与运动恢复和康复依从性有关。关注患者出院后的运动恐惧变化，并针对性干预，可能有助于改善长期康复效果。
items.titleZh: 卒中后偏瘫患者出院后的运动恐惧轨迹与康复结局。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 296 名卒中后偏瘫患者的单中心前瞻性纵向研究，确定了出院后 6 个月的运动恐惧轨迹，并发现其与运动恢复和康复锻炼依从性之间存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective study reveals the trajectories of kinesiophobia in post-stroke hemiplegia patients after discharge and links it to motor recovery and rehabilitation adherence. Monitoring changes in kinesiophobia post-discharge and providing targeted interventions may improve long-term rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 单中心研究可能限制结果的外推性，且运动恐惧的测量依赖于自评量表。
items.limitationEn: The single-center nature of the study may limit generalizability, and kinesiophobia measurement relies on self-report scales.

items.title: Structured exercise training for fatigue management in multiple sclerosis: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
items.summary: An umbrella review synthesizing evidence from systematic reviews and meta-analyses confirms the effectiveness of structured exercise training for fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis, with effects varying across exercise modalities and fatigue instruments.
items.curatedReason: 结构化运动训练对多发性硬化症（MS）相关疲劳有效性明确。这篇伞形综述强化了运动作为 MS 疲劳管理一线干预的地位，下次患者咨询时，可以更有底气地建议其开始运动计划。
items.titleZh: 结构化运动训练对多发性硬化症疲劳管理的疗效：系统综述和荟萃分析的伞形综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项伞形综述综合了系统综述和荟萃分析的证据，证实结构化运动训练对多发性硬化症患者的疲劳有效，但不同运动方式和疲劳测量工具下的效果有所差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Structured exercise training is clearly effective for fatigue in multiple sclerosis (MS). This umbrella review solidifies exercise as a first-line intervention for MS-related fatigue. When patients inquire, you can confidently recommend they initiate an exercise program.
items.limitation: 伞形综述可能存在原纳入研究的发表偏倚和异质性问题，需结合具体系统综述评估。
items.limitationEn: Umbrella reviews may be subject to publication bias and heterogeneity from their included systematic reviews, requiring evaluation of specific systematic reviews.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effectiveness of an AI-based home exercise app for rehabilitation of rotator cuff-related shoulder pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A single-center RCT (N=46) found that adding an AI-based digital rehabilitation program to standard physiotherapy significantly improved pain, function, and fear-avoidance beliefs, and reduced healthcare utilization in patients with rotator cuff-related shoulder pain.
items.curatedReason: 肩袖相关肩痛的康复，基于 AI 的家庭运动 App 结合传统理疗效果显著，尤其在依从性管理上有优势。虽然是单中心小样本，但对于考虑远程康复方案的诊所，这提示了一个可行的技术路径。
items.titleZh: AI 家庭运动 App 对肩袖相关肩痛康复的有效性：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心随机对照试验（N=46）发现，在标准物理治疗基础上增加 AI 家庭康复计划，能显著改善肩袖相关肩痛患者的疼痛、功能和恐惧回避信念，并减少医疗资源使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: For rotator cuff-related shoulder pain, an AI-based home exercise app combined with traditional physiotherapy showed significant benefits, particularly in improving adherence. Though a single-center pilot, it suggests a viable technological pathway for clinics considering telerehabilitation solutions.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心小样本 RCT (N=46)，结果推广性有限，需更大规模多中心研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center, small-sample RCT (N=46), limiting generalizability; larger, multi-center studies are needed for validation.

items.title: Remotely Monitored Home-based Pulmonary Rehabilitation in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: Results of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=29) in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis on antifibrotic therapy found that a 12-week asynchronously remotely monitored, exercise-focused home pulmonary rehabilitation program significantly improved exercise capacity (increase in 6MWD by 31.6 meters; p=0.03).
items.curatedReason: 家庭远程监测的肺康复在特发性肺纤维化（IPF）患者中显示出可行性和有效性。这为那些无法进行医院内康复的 IPF 患者提供了一个重要的替代方案，拓展了肺康复的服务边界。
items.titleZh: 远程监测的特发性肺纤维化居家肺康复：一项随机对照试验的结果。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对接受抗纤维化治疗的特发性肺纤维化患者的随机对照试验（N=29）发现，为期 12 周的异步远程监测、以运动为重点的居家肺康复项目显著改善了运动能力（6MWD 增加 31.6 米；p=0.03）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Remotely monitored home-based pulmonary rehabilitation demonstrates feasibility and effectiveness in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) patients. This offers a crucial alternative for IPF patients unable to access in-hospital rehabilitation, expanding the reach of pulmonary rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（n=29），为单中心试验，可能限制了结果的普遍适用性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=29) and was single-center, potentially limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Content validity, reliability, and agreement between in-person and video-call assessments of the modified bradykinesia rating scale (MBRS).
items.summary: The Modified Bradykinesia Rating Scale (MBRS) showed adequate content validity, good test-retest reliability (ICC=0.98), inter-rater reliability (ICC=0.97), and agreement between in-person and video-call assessments (ICC=0.97) for assessing bradykinesia in individuals with Parkinson's disease.
items.curatedReason: 改良版运动迟缓评定量表 (MBRS) 具有良好的内容效度、重测信度和评定者间信度，并且现场评估和视频通话评估一致性高。这意味着你可以在远程医疗场景中，更放心地使用 MBRS 评估帕金森病患者的运动迟缓。
items.titleZh: 改良版运动迟缓评定量表 (MBRS) 的内容效度、信度以及现场与视频通话评估的一致性。
items.summaryZh: 改良版运动迟缓评定量表 (MBRS) 在评估帕金森病患者的运动迟缓方面，显示出足够的内容效度、良好的重测信度 (ICC=0.98) 和评定者间信度 (ICC=0.97)，以及现场与视频通话评估之间的高度一致性 (ICC=0.97)。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Modified Bradykinesia Rating Scale (MBRS) demonstrates good content, test-retest, and inter-rater reliability, with high agreement between in-person and video-call assessments. This means you can more confidently use the MBRS for assessing bradykinesia in Parkinson's patients in telehealth settings.
items.limitation: 本研究为方法学研究，评估的是量表的信效度而非干预效果，结果不能直接用于临床决策。
items.limitationEn: This methodological study assessed scale reliability and validity, not intervention efficacy; its results cannot directly inform clinical decisions.

items.title: In adult patients with brainstem strokes, does dysphagia rehabilitation improve health-related outcomes compared to usual care for inpatients? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 studies (443 participants) suggests that dysphagia rehabilitation is effective in improving swallow function in inpatients with brainstem stroke, with interventions categorized into traditional swallowing therapy or inclusion of devices.
items.curatedReason: 脑干卒中住院患者的吞咽康复是有效的，无论是传统疗法还是器械辅助，都应早期、积极介入。基于12项研究的系统综述和荟萃分析，这明确支持了我们在这类病例中对吞咽功能进行干预的必要性。
items.titleZh: 脑干卒中住院患者吞咽康复与常规护理相比，能否改善健康相关结局？一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 12 项研究（443 名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析表明，吞咽康复对脑干卒中住院患者的吞咽功能改善有效，干预措施分为传统吞咽疗法和器械辅助疗法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Dysphagia rehabilitation is effective for inpatients with brainstem stroke, whether using traditional therapy or devices; early and aggressive intervention is warranted. This systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 studies strongly supports the necessity of our interventions for swallow function in these cases.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的 RCT 数量有限且异质性较高，可能影响荟萃分析结果的稳健性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number and high heterogeneity of included RCTs may affect the robustness of the meta-analysis results.

items.title: Responsiveness of the Arabic version of the lower extremity functional scale in individuals with lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders.
items.summary: The Arabic version of the Lower Extremity Functional Scale (LEFS) showed good responsiveness in 74 participants with lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders, with LEFS change scores correlating well with changes in other outcome measures.
items.curatedReason: LEFS 阿拉伯语版在下肢肌骨疾病患者中表现出良好的反应性。这意味着，当你评估该语言背景的患者时，可以放心使用 LEFS 量表进行疗效追踪。
items.titleZh: 下肢功能量表阿拉伯语版在下肢肌肉骨骼疾病患者中的反应性。
items.summaryZh: 下肢功能量表（LEFS）的阿拉伯语版在 74 名下肢肌肉骨骼疾病患者中显示出良好的反应性，其变化分数与其他结局指标的变化呈良好相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Arabic version of LEFS demonstrated good responsiveness in individuals with lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders. This means you can reliably use the LEFS for outcome tracking when assessing patients from this linguistic background.
items.limitation: 本研究为方法学研究，评估的是量表的反应性而非干预效果，结果不能直接用于临床决策。
items.limitationEn: This methodological study assessed scale responsiveness, not intervention efficacy; its results cannot directly inform clinical decisions.

items.title: Research progress on horticultural therapy in patients with post-stroke cognitive impairment: a narrative review.
items.summary: A narrative review suggests horticultural therapy significantly improves memory, executive function, and orientation in post-stroke cognitive impairment patients, also benefiting mood and ADL, via sequential and repetitive cognitive demands.
items.curatedReason: 园艺疗法对卒中后认知障碍患者的认知、情绪和日常生活活动能力有积极影响。这提示了一个有趣且参与度高的新型辅助干预路径，但在常规临床实践中纳入前，你仍需等待更高级别的证据。
items.titleZh: 卒中后认知障碍患者园艺疗法研究进展：叙述性综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项叙述性综述表明，园艺疗法通过序列和重复的认知需求，显著改善卒中后认知障碍患者的记忆、执行功能和定向力，并对情绪和日常生活活动能力有益。
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，证据级别相对较低，无法提供明确的临床干预指南。
items.limitationEn: This narrative review provides a relatively low level of evidence and cannot offer definitive clinical intervention guidelines.

items.title: Effects of Short-term High-intensity vs. Moderate-intensity Interval Training on Cardiopulmonary Fitness and Metabolic Health in Overweight or Obese Patients with Cardiovascular Disease: Evidence from China.
items.summary: A retrospective study (N=145) compared 4-week supervised HIIT (N=63) vs. MIIT (N=82) in overweight/obese CVD patients. Both improved cardiopulmonary fitness (VO2peak) and metabolic health, but MIIT showed significantly better adherence (98.8% vs. 90.5%, p=0.02).
items.curatedReason: 对于超重或肥胖的心血管疾病患者，高强度间歇训练（HIIT）和中等强度间歇训练（MIIT）都能改善心肺健康和代谢指标。MIIT 组表现出更好的依从性。在实践中，您应根据患者的接受程度和具体情况，灵活选择训练强度，MIIT 可能是更现实的方案。
items.titleZh: 短期高强度 vs. 中等强度间歇训练对超重或肥胖心血管疾病患者心肺健康和代谢的影响：来自中国的证据。
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性研究（N=145）比较了超重或肥胖的心血管疾病患者进行 4 周监督下高强度间歇训练（N=63）与中等强度间歇训练（N=82）的效果。两组均改善了心肺健康（VO2peak）和代谢指标，但中等强度组依从性显著更优（98.8% 对 90.5%，p=0.02）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both high-intensity interval training (HIIT) and moderate-intensity interval training (MIIT) improve cardiopulmonary fitness and metabolic health in overweight or obese patients with cardiovascular disease. The MIIT group showed better adherence. In practice, you should flexibly choose training intensity based on patient acceptance and specific conditions, with MIIT potentially being a more realistic option.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性研究，存在选择偏倚和混杂因素的风险，无法建立明确的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective study carries risks of selection bias and confounding factors, thus unable to establish definitive causality.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: The Association of Depression, Anxiety, and Quality of Life with Sexual Function in Young-to-Middle-Aged Stroke Patients: A Case-Control Study.
items.summary: A case-control study of young-to-middle-aged stroke patients (n=30) found significantly higher rates of sexual dysfunction compared to controls (19.3 ± 6.6 vs. 13.0 ± 3.1, p < 0.001), associated with depression, anxiety, and poorer quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 这项病例对照研究强调了卒中后年轻患者性功能障碍的高患病率，以及与抑郁、焦虑和生活质量的关联。这提示你应更早将性健康纳入卒中康复的评估和干预中。
items.titleZh: 中青年卒中患者的抑郁、焦虑和生活质量与性功能的关系：一项病例对照研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项中青年卒中患者（n=30）的病例对照研究发现，与对照组相比，卒中患者性功能障碍发生率显著更高（19.3 ± 6.6 vs. 13.0 ± 3.1, p < 0.001），且与抑郁、焦虑和生活质量下降相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case-control study highlights the high prevalence of sexual dysfunction in younger stroke patients and its association with depression, anxiety, and quality of life. This suggests you should integrate sexual health into stroke rehabilitation assessment and intervention earlier.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本（n=30）病例对照研究，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a small sample (n=30) case-control study, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Information and communication technologies in implementation strategies promoting allied health professionals' guideline adherence in post-acute stroke care: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review mapped the use of information and communication technologies (ICTs) in implementation strategies to promote allied health professionals' guideline adherence in post-acute stroke care, categorizing ICTs based on targeted determinants of practice.
items.curatedReason: 这份综述表明，ICTs 在卒中后康复中确实有潜力提升专职医疗人员的指南依从性。你应当思考如何将这些分类的 ICT 工具，例如远程监控或决策支持系统，整合到你的实践中，以标准化护理流程。
items.titleZh: 信息通信技术在促进卒中后期康复中专职医疗人员指南依从性策略中的应用：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述梳理了信息通信技术（ICTs）在卒中后期康复指南实施策略中的应用，并根据其作用目标对 ICTs 进行了分类。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review confirms ICTs have the potential to boost allied health professionals' guideline adherence in post-acute stroke care. You should consider how to integrate these categorized ICT tools, such as remote monitoring or decision support systems, into your practice to standardize care pathways.

items.title: Correlation of Motor-Task Related Brain Activation Changes With Motor Performance Changes Induced by Constraint-Induced Therapy After Stroke.
items.summary: An fMRI study in 42 hemiparetic stroke patients undergoing Constraint-Induced Movement Therapy (CIMT) found changes in motor-task related brain activation correlated with improvements in functional recovery assessed by the Wolf Motor Function Test.
items.curatedReason: 这项 fMRI 研究为约束诱导运动疗法（CIMT）改善卒中后运动功能提供了神经影像学证据，显示了脑激活变化与功能恢复的关联。这加强了 CIMT 的循证基础，让你在临床沟通时更有底气。
items.titleZh: 卒中后约束诱导运动疗法引起的运动任务相关脑激活变化与运动表现变化的关联。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 42 名偏瘫卒中患者进行的 fMRI 研究发现，约束诱导运动疗法（CIMT）后运动任务相关脑激活的变化与 Wolf 运动功能测试评估的功能恢复改善相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This fMRI study provides neuroimaging evidence for Constraint-Induced Movement Therapy (CIMT) improving motor function after stroke, showing a correlation between brain activation changes and functional recovery. This strengthens CIMT's evidence base, bolstering your confidence in clinical communication.
items.limitation: 研究设计仅纳入亚急性期和慢性期卒中患者（n=42），结果不一定适用于所有卒中患者。
items.limitationEn: The study design included only subacute and chronic stroke patients (n=42), so the results may not apply to all stroke patients.

items.title: Multimodal Phenotyping of Myofascial Pain Syndrome Using Rotational Shear Wave Elastography and Clinical Network Analysis
items.summary: A study explored multimodal phenotyping of myofascial pain syndrome (MPS) using rotational shear wave elastography (SWE), bioimpedance spectroscopy (BIS), range of motion (ROM), and patient-reported outcomes (PROs) in 71 adults, aiming to objectively characterize MPS subgroups.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 71 名成年人的观察研究提示，多模态评估（如旋转剪切波弹性成像、生物阻抗谱）可能为肌筋膜疼痛综合征 (MPS) 提供更客观的生物标志物，超越单纯的 ROM 和 PROs。这有助于我们更精细地识别 MPS 亚型，但目前仍是探索阶段，距离临床常规应用尚远。
items.titleZh: 利用旋转剪切波弹性成像和临床网络分析对肌筋膜疼痛综合征进行多模态表型分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项研究通过旋转剪切波弹性成像（SWE）、生物阻抗谱（BIS）、关节活动度（ROM）和患者报告结果（PROs）对 71 名成人肌筋膜疼痛综合征（MPS）进行多模态表型分析，旨在客观描述 MPS 亚组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study of 71 adults suggests multimodal assessments, such as rotational shear wave elastography and bioimpedance spectroscopy, might offer more objective biomarkers for Myofascial Pain Syndrome (MPS) than ROM and PROs alone. While this could lead to more nuanced MPS subtyping, it's still an exploratory finding and far from routine clinical application.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（71 名成人），且为初步探索性研究，需要更大规模和更多中心验证。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size (71 adults) and is preliminary and exploratory, requiring larger and multi-center validation.

items.title: Clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty: revision 2026.
items.summary: An American Physical Therapy Association volunteer group has updated the clinical practice guideline for total knee arthroplasty, formulating 20 recommendations based on a systematic review of current literature.
items.curatedReason: PTA 发布了全膝关节置换术（TKA）物理治疗管理指南的 2026 年修订版。这份循证指南综合了最新文献，提供了 20 条具体建议，是你在 TKA 术后康复中优化治疗方案、确保最佳实践的重要参考。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术物理治疗管理临床实践指南：2026 年修订版
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会工作组更新了全膝关节置换术的临床实践指南，基于系统综述制定了 20 条建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: The APTA has released the 2026 revision of its clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty (TKA). This evidence-based guideline synthesizes the latest literature and offers 20 specific recommendations, serving as a crucial resource for optimizing treatment plans and ensuring best practices in TKA post-operative rehabilitation.

items.title: Models Containing the Braden Scale Predict Activities of Daily Living Improvement in Post-Stroke Hemiplegia: A Single Center Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A single-center retrospective cohort study on 324 post-stroke hemiplegia patients developed a predictive model integrating the Braden scale to forecast activities of daily living (ADL) recovery and evaluated a comprehensive rehabilitation program.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究提示，将 Braden 量表纳入预测模型有助于评估卒中偏瘫患者日常生活活动能力（ADL）的改善潜力。这能帮你更早期识别高危患者，并据此调整康复策略和预后沟通。
items.titleZh: 包含 Braden 量表的模型可预测卒中偏瘫患者日常生活活动能力改善：一项单中心回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 324 例卒中偏瘫患者进行的单中心回顾性队列研究发现，整合 Braden 量表的模型可预测日常生活活动（ADL）的改善，并评估了综合康复计划的效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study suggests that incorporating the Braden scale into predictive models can help assess the potential for ADL improvement in post-stroke hemiplegia patients. This enables earlier identification of at-risk patients and allows for tailored rehabilitation strategies and prognosis communication.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性队列研究，可能存在选择偏倚和数据完整性问题，且结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective cohort study, which may be subject to selection bias and data integrity issues, with limited generalizability of results.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Sensory integration strategies for static balance control in older adults with knee osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A repeated-measures study on 69 knee osteoarthritis patients investigated sensory integration strategies for static balance control, recording static balance metrics under various conditions to estimate sensory contributions.
items.curatedReason: 这项对膝骨关节炎（KOA）患者平衡控制感官整合策略的研究，进一步揭示了本体感觉、视觉和前庭感觉在静态平衡中的作用。它为你理解 KOA 患者跌倒风险的神经生理学机制，进而设计针对性的平衡训练方案提供了理论基础。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎老年人静态平衡控制的感官整合策略
items.summaryZh: 一项对 69 例膝骨关节炎患者进行的重复测量研究，调查了静态平衡控制中的感官整合策略，并通过不同条件下的平衡指标估计了感官贡献。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study on sensory integration strategies for balance control in knee osteoarthritis (KOA) patients further elucidates the roles of proprioception, vision, and vestibular sensation in static balance. It provides a theoretical basis for understanding the neurophysiological mechanisms of fall risk in KOA patients and designing targeted balance training programs.
items.limitation: 这项研究没有干预措施，仅为一项初步的观察性研究，不能直接指导临床干预方案的制定。
items.limitationEn: This study lacked interventions and was a preliminary observational study, thus it cannot directly guide the development of clinical intervention protocols.

items.title: The effects of a falls prevention app (SAFE app) on community-dwelling adults' fall risk category: Single-blinded randomized control pilot trial.
items.summary: A single-blinded randomized controlled pilot trial on 54 community-dwelling adults aged 65 and older evaluated the effects of a 12-week app-based home exercise program on fall risk category.
items.curatedReason: 这款基于 App 的防跌倒家庭锻炼程序在社区老年人中显示出降低跌倒风险的潜力。虽然是初步的试点研究，但它提示了远程康复在老年防跌倒领域的价值，未来可考虑将其作为传统防跌倒干预的有效补充。
items.titleZh: 防跌倒 App (SAFE app) 对社区老年人跌倒风险类别的影响：一项单盲随机对照试点试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 54 名 65 岁以上社区老年人进行的单盲随机对照试点试验，评估了为期 12 周的 App 家庭锻炼计划对跌倒风险类别的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This app-based fall prevention home exercise program shows potential in reducing fall risk among community-dwelling older adults. While a preliminary pilot study, it highlights the value of telerehabilitation in geriatric fall prevention, suggesting its future role as an effective complement to traditional interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本（N=54）单盲试点 RCT，可能存在局限性，需要更大规模研究进一步验证其长期效果和普遍适用性。
items.limitationEn: This was a small-sample (N=54) single-blinded pilot RCT, which may have limitations, and larger studies are needed to further validate its long-term effects and generalizability.

items.title: Tavapadon Improves Motor Symptoms in Parkinson’s Disease: Lancet
items.summary: The phase 3 TEMPO-2 trial, published in The Lancet Neurology, found that tavapadon significantly and clinically meaningfully improved motor symptoms in Parkinson’s disease patients over 27 weeks.
items.curatedReason: Tavapadon 作为选择性多巴胺 D1/D5 受体激动剂在改善帕金森病运动症状方面展现出显著效果。虽然这是药物研究，但它提示了未来帕金森病患者运动功能改善的药物支持，这将影响你的康复方案制定。
items.titleZh: Tavapadon 改善帕金森病运动症状：柳叶刀报告
items.summaryZh: 发表在《柳叶刀神经病学》上的 3 期 TEMPO-2 试验发现，Tavapadon 在 27 周内显著且有临床意义地改善了帕金森病患者的运动症状。
items.curatedReasonEn: Tavapadon, a selective dopamine D1/D5 receptor agonist, shows significant improvements in motor symptoms for Parkinson's disease. While a drug study, this indicates future pharmaceutical support for motor function in PD patients, influencing your rehabilitation planning.

items.title: Ensifentrine Improves Lung Function in Chinese Patients With COPD: Study
items.summary: A new study in CHEST Journal reported that ensifentrine, a novel dual PDE3/4 inhibitor, significantly improved lung function, respiratory symptoms, and quality of life in Chinese patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
items.curatedReason: Ensifentrine 在中国 COPD 患者中显示出改善肺功能、呼吸症状和生活质量的潜力。作为一种新型药物，它的广泛应用可能改变你未来在 COPD 康复中药物辅助与运动疗法的配合策略。
items.titleZh: 研究显示 Ensifentrine 改善中国 COPD 患者肺功能
items.summaryZh: 《CHEST》杂志一项新研究报告称，新型双重 PDE3/4 抑制剂 ensifentrine 显著改善了中国慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）患者的肺功能、呼吸症状和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: Ensifentrine shows potential to improve lung function, respiratory symptoms, and quality of life in Chinese COPD patients. As a new drug, its widespread use could alter your future strategy for integrating medication and exercise therapy in COPD rehabilitation.

items.title: Neuroprotective effects of lixisenatide against propagation of α-synuclein pathology in Parkinson's disease
items.summary: This article discusses the neuroprotective effects of lixisenatide against the propagation of α-synuclein pathology in Parkinson's disease, exploring its potential as a disease-modifying treatment.
items.curatedReason: 这项关于利西那肽神经保护作用的研究，虽然是药物机制探索，但它揭示了帕金森病进展的新靶点。作为康复医师，你需要了解这些生物学进展，以更好地与医疗团队协作，理解患者病情进展的潜在因素。
items.titleZh: 利西那肽对抗帕金森病中 α-突触核蛋白病理传播的神经保护作用
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了利西那肽对抗帕金森病中 α-突触核蛋白病理传播的神经保护作用，探索其作为疾病改善疗法的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study on lixisenatide's neuroprotective effects, though exploring drug mechanisms, reveals new targets for Parkinson's disease progression. As a rehabilitation clinician, understanding these biological advancements helps you collaborate better with the medical team and understand potential factors in patient progression.

items.title: Comment on “swedish massage versus hip strengthening exercises for pain and function in older adults with knee osteoarthritis: a randomized controlled trial”
items.summary: This article is a published comment on a randomized controlled trial comparing Swedish massage with hip strengthening exercises for pain and function in older adults with knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评本身不提供新的临床证据。鉴于其评论的是一项 RCT，你应关注其中关于研究方法学和局限性的讨论，这能帮你更批判性地评估类似研究。
items.titleZh: 对“瑞典式按摩与髋部强化运动对老年膝骨关节炎患者疼痛和功能影响的随机对照试验”的评论
items.summaryZh: 本文是对一项关于瑞典式按摩与髋部强化运动治疗老年膝骨关节炎患者疼痛和功能的随机对照试验的评论。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary offers no new clinical evidence. Since it critiques an RCT, pay attention to its discussion of methodological details and limitations; this will help you critically appraise similar studies.

items.title: Neurosurgeon in focus Q&A with Dr Michael Lebenstein-Gumovski
items.summary: An interview with Dr. Michael Lebenstein-Gumovski, a neurosurgeon, highlights his advanced research in spinal cord injury restoration and transplantation at the Sklifosovsky Clinical and Research Institute for Emergency Medicine.
items.curatedReason: 这篇访谈聚焦脊髓损伤修复前沿，虽非直接临床实践，但了解神经外科在该领域的探索（如脊髓移植）能拓宽你的视野，知晓未来康复干预的潜在生物学基础。
items.titleZh: 神经外科医生聚焦：与 Michael Lebenstein-Gumovski 博士问答
items.summaryZh: 对神经外科医生 Michael Lebenstein-Gumovski 博士的访谈，重点介绍了他在斯克利福索夫斯基临床和急诊医学研究所进行的脊髓损伤修复和移植方面的前沿研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This interview focuses on frontiers in spinal cord injury repair. While not directly clinical practice, understanding neurosurgical explorations in this field (e.g., spinal cord transplantation) broadens your perspective and informs potential biological foundations for future rehabilitation interventions.

items.title: Clinical implementation of artificial intelligence in adolescent mental healthcare
items.summary: A review summarizes recent literature on AI tools for adolescent mental health, covering types, clinical applications, effectiveness, safety, and ethical considerations, noting most effective studies focus on depression.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述关注 AI 在青少年心理健康中的应用，主要涉及诊断支持、治疗辅助和聊天机器人。物理治疗师可从中了解 AI 在整体医疗中的角色，但它不直接指导物理治疗实践。
items.titleZh: 人工智能在青少年心理健康护理中的临床应用
items.summaryZh: 一篇综述总结了人工智能工具在青少年心理健康领域的最新文献，涵盖了工具类型、临床应用、有效性、安全性及伦理考量，并指出大多数有效性研究集中在抑郁症治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review focuses on AI in adolescent mental health, covering diagnostic support, therapeutic assistance, and chatbots. Physical therapists can learn about AI's role in overall healthcare, but it doesn't directly guide PT practice.
items.limitation: 本综述侧重于AI在青少年心理健康领域的应用，对外推到物理治疗实践的指导有限。
items.limitationEn: This review focuses on AI applications in adolescent mental health, offering limited direct guidance for physical therapy practice.

items.title: Heart failure ‘polypill’ improves cardiac function, cuts hospitalization risk: Study
items.summary: A study led by Michigan Medicine and UT Southwestern Medical Center found that a "polypill" combining multiple medications significantly improved cardiac function and reduced hospitalizations for heart failure patients compared to standard multi-medication treatment.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究关于心力衰竭“多合一药丸”的有效性。它直接涉及药物干预，而非康复治疗。对物理治疗师来说，了解这类药物进展很重要，但它并不直接指导你的临床实践。
items.titleZh: 研究：心力衰竭“多合一药丸”改善心脏功能，降低住院风险
items.summaryZh: 密歇根医学和 UT 西南医学中心牵头的一项研究发现，与标准多药治疗相比，结合多种药物的“多合一药丸”显著改善了心力衰竭患者的心脏功能并降低了住院率。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study focuses on the efficacy of a "polypill" for heart failure, a direct drug intervention, not rehabilitation. While understanding such drug advancements is important for physical therapists, it doesn't directly guide your clinical practice.

items.title: Effect of Visual Modification by Video See-Through Augmented Reality with REHA-Glasses on Postural Verticality in Individuals with Post-Stroke Lateropulsion.
items.summary: An exploratory single-arm study investigated whether REHA-glasses, which modify visual input based on body tilt, could correct lateropulsion in individuals with acute post-stroke lateropulsion, suggesting a potential for improving postural verticality.
items.curatedReason: 视频透视增强现实技术用于卒中后偏向推注患者显示出初步潜力。这项单臂探索性研究提示该技术可能有助于改善姿势垂直性，但其长期疗效、适用人群和与传统康复结合的策略尚待更多高质量证据确证。
items.titleZh: 视频透视增强现实眼镜对卒中后偏向推注患者姿势垂直性的视觉修正效果研究
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性单臂研究评估了 REHA-glasses（一种根据身体倾斜调整视觉输入的增强现实眼镜）是否能纠正急性卒中后偏向推注患者的姿势垂直性，初步结果提示其具有改善姿势垂直性的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Video see-through augmented reality shows initial promise for post-stroke lateropulsion. This single-arm exploratory study suggests its potential in improving postural verticality, but long-term efficacy, suitable patient populations, and integration with traditional rehabilitation require further high-quality evidence.
items.limitation: 这是一项单臂、探索性研究，缺乏对照组，且样本量和随访期未在摘要中明确说明，因此结果需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-arm, exploratory study lacking a control group, and the sample size and follow-up period are not clearly stated in the abstract, so results should be interpreted with caution.

items.title: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis: a systematic review exploring efficacy and optimal technique.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 103 studies (9951 patients, 44 RCTs) explored the efficacy and optimal technique of hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis. The median hydrodilatation volume across studies was 28 mL (range: 8.3-200 mL).
items.curatedReason: 关于肩周炎水扩张术，别再纠结最佳注射量了。这项纳入 44 项 RCT 的高质量系统综述表明，28 mL 的中位注射量已足够，更大剂量并无额外益处。
items.titleZh: 肩周炎水扩张术：系统综述探讨疗效与最佳技术
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 103 项研究（9951 名患者，44 项 RCT）的系统综述和 meta 分析评估了水扩张术治疗肩周炎的疗效和最佳技术。研究发现水扩张术的注射量中位数为 28 mL（范围：8.3-200 mL）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stop overthinking the optimal injection volume for hydrodilatation in adhesive capsulitis. This high-quality systematic review, incorporating 44 RCTs, indicates that a median volume of 28 mL is sufficient; larger volumes offer no additional benefit.
items.limitation: 本综述未明确报告水扩张术与其他干预措施在长期效果上的显著差异。
items.limitationEn: The review did not explicitly report significant long-term differences in efficacy between hydrodilatation and other interventions.

items.title: Effects of resistance-band shoulder exercise on pain, range of motion, and functional disability in diabetic adults with adhesive capsulitis: a pilot randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A pilot randomized controlled trial with 28 diabetic adults with adhesive capsulitis evaluated resistance-band shoulder exercises, showing effects on pain, range of motion, and functional disability.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步的随机对照试验提示弹力带训练对糖尿病合并肩周炎患者有效。虽然样本量小，但它为这类特定人群的运动干预提供了早期证据，为后续大规模研究奠定基础。
items.titleZh: 弹力带肩部锻炼对糖尿病合并肩周炎患者疼痛、活动度及功能障碍的影响：一项初步随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 28 名糖尿病合并肩周炎成年人的初步随机对照试验评估了弹力带肩部锻炼计划的效果，结果显示其对疼痛、活动度及功能障碍有改善作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that resistance-band exercise is effective for diabetic adults with adhesive capsulitis. Despite the small sample size, it provides early evidence for exercise intervention in this specific population, laying the groundwork for larger future studies.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的随机对照试验，样本量仅有 28 人，限制了结果的普遍性和统计学效力。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot randomized controlled trial with a small sample size of only 28 participants, limiting the generalizability and statistical power of the results.

items.title: Wearable vibrotactile stimulation shirts and gloves for upper extremity stroke rehabilitation: A pilot randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A pilot randomized controlled trial with 24 ischemic stroke patients investigated the safety, feasibility, and efficacy of wearable vibrotactile stimulation shirts and gloves for upper extremity stroke rehabilitation, using FMA-UE motor score as the primary outcome.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点 RCT 表明，可穿戴振动触觉刺激设备在卒中上肢康复中显示出安全性和可行性，并可能改善运动功能。虽然还需要大规模研究，但你可以开始关注这类新型设备作为传统康复的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴振动触觉刺激衣物和手套在卒中上肢康复中的应用：一项试点随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 24 名缺血性卒中患者的试点 RCT 评估了可穿戴振动触觉刺激衣物和手套在上肢康复中的安全性、可行性和有效性，主要结局指标为 Fugl-Meyer 评估上肢运动评分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT indicates that wearable vibrotactile stimulation devices are safe and feasible for upper extremity stroke rehabilitation and may improve motor function. While larger studies are needed, you can start monitoring these novel devices as adjuncts to traditional rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本试点 RCT（24 名患者），其发现的疗效需要更大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a small pilot RCT (24 patients), and its efficacy findings require validation in larger studies.

items.title: Could sensorimotor factors in acute low back pain explain long-term pain and disability? A secondary analysis of longitudinal data from a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A secondary analysis of longitudinal data from 99 participants with acute low back pain explored causal associations between pain sensitivity and erector spinae muscle activation in the acute phase and pain/disability at 6- and 12-month follow-ups.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，急性腰痛期的感觉运动因素可能预示长期疼痛和残疾，特别是腰部肌肉激活水平。在评估急性腰痛时，除了疼痛本身，还需要关注这些早期生物力学指标。
items.titleZh: 急性腰痛中的感觉运动因素能否解释长期疼痛和残疾？一项随机对照试验纵向数据的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 99 名急性腰痛患者的纵向数据二次分析，探讨了急性期疼痛敏感性和竖脊肌激活与 6 个月及 12 个月时疼痛和残疾的因果关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that sensorimotor factors in acute low back pain, particularly lumbar muscle activation, may predict long-term pain and disability. When assessing acute LBP, consider these early biomechanical indicators beyond just pain.
items.limitation: 这是一项针对急性腰痛患者的观察性研究，不能建立因果关系，且样本量为 99 人，外推性有待验证。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study of acute low back pain patients, which cannot establish causality, and with a sample size of 99, generalizability requires further validation.

items.title: Motor impairment, balance, and muscle coactivation limit the effectiveness of voluntary corrections of asymmetry during walking after stroke
items.summary: This study with 28 individuals with chronic stroke identified biomechanical, neuromuscular, and cognitive characteristics associated with the ability to perform voluntary corrections of walking using explicit visual feedback, revealing limitations from motor impairment, balance, and muscle coactivation.
items.curatedReason: 这项 28 例研究提示，在卒中后步行训练中，不仅要关注视觉反馈，还应评估和管理患者的运动障碍、平衡缺陷及肌肉共激活模式，这可能比单纯反馈更重要。
items.titleZh: 运动障碍、平衡和肌肉共激活限制卒中后步行不对称自主纠正的有效性
items.summaryZh: 一项对 28 名慢性卒中患者的研究发现，运动障碍、平衡和肌肉共激活限制了其在视觉反馈下进行步行不对称自主纠正的能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study of 28 individuals suggests that in post-stroke gait training, attention should be paid not only to visual feedback but also to assessing and managing patients' motor impairments, balance deficits, and muscle co-activation patterns, which might be more critical than feedback alone.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心横断面研究，样本量为 28 名慢性卒中患者，结果的外推性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-session, cross-sectional study with 28 chronic stroke individuals, which may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Beyond "Biomedical-Plus": Reclaiming the biopsychosocial model in musculoskeletal physiotherapy.
items.summary: This commentary argues that musculoskeletal physiotherapy often implements the biopsychosocial (BPS) model as "biomedical-plus" care. It proposes that physiotherapists can achieve a more authentic BPS application through three foundational conditions: professional Confidence, role Clarity, and Compassionate communication.
items.curatedReason: 你的生物心理社会模型实践是否落入了“生物医学+”的窠臼？这篇评论文章强调，要真正实现整合，你需要关注专业自信（Confidence）、角色清晰（Clarity）和同情心沟通（Compassionate communication）。审视自身，提升 BPS 模型应用的深度。
items.titleZh: 超越“生物医学+”：在肌肉骨骼物理治疗中重申生物心理社会模型
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论文章指出，肌肉骨骼物理治疗在实践生物心理社会（BPS）模型时常陷入“生物医学+”的模式。文章提出，物理治疗师可通过建立专业自信、明确角色定位和富有同情心的沟通这三个基础条件，实现更真实的 BPS 模型应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Is your biopsychosocial model practice falling into the “biomedical-plus” trap? This commentary emphasizes that true integration requires focusing on professional Confidence, role Clarity, and Compassionate communication. Reflect on your own practice to deepen your application of the BPS model.

items.title: Exploring equity in telehealth interventions in physiotherapy: A meta-epidemiological study.
items.summary: This meta-epidemiological study assessed equity in telehealth physiotherapy interventions using the PROGRESS Plus framework, analyzing 94 randomized controlled trials from 2020-2023 to understand how telehealth addresses or exacerbates health disparities.
items.curatedReason: 远程物理治疗的公平性研究表明，尽管技术能带来便利，但在实践中仍可能存在不平等。审视你的远程治疗方案，确保你在推广和应用远程康复时，能更好地覆盖所有患者群体，避免加剧健康不公平。
items.titleZh: 探讨物理治疗中远程医疗干预的公平性：一项荟萃流行病学研究
items.summaryZh: 这项荟萃流行病学研究利用 PROGRESS Plus 框架，评估了物理治疗中远程医疗干预的公平性，分析了 2020-2023 年的 94 项随机对照试验，以了解远程医疗如何解决或加剧健康差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Research on equity in telehealth physical therapy suggests that despite technological convenience, inequalities may persist in practice. Review your telehealth protocols to ensure that when promoting and applying telerehabilitation, you can better reach all patient groups and avoid exacerbating health inequities.
items.limitation: 本研究为荟萃流行病学研究，依赖于现有 RCT 的报告质量，可能无法完全捕捉真实世界的公平性问题。
items.limitationEn: This meta-epidemiological study relies on the reporting quality of existing RCTs and may not fully capture real-world equity issues.

items.title: Spine-related leg pain: Definitions, etiology, clinical presentation, and management.
items.summary: This review clarifies inconsistent terminology in spine-related leg pain (SRLP) by detailing the International Association for the Study of Pain (IASP) classification, distinguishing between radiculopathy, radicular pain, and somatic referred pain.
items.curatedReason: 脊柱相关腿痛的诊断分类依然混乱，直接影响你的诊断和治疗决策。这份综述是 IASP 最新分类（根性病变、根性痛、躯体牵涉痛）的权威解读，用它统一科室内部术语，提升诊疗一致性。
items.titleZh: 脊柱相关腿痛：定义、病因、临床表现与管理
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述通过详细阐述国际疼痛研究协会（IASP）的分类，澄清了脊柱相关腿痛（SRLP）术语上的不一致，区分了神经根病、神经根痛和躯体牵涉痛。
items.curatedReasonEn: The diagnostic classification of spine-related leg pain remains confusing, directly impacting your diagnostic and treatment decisions. This review offers an authoritative interpretation of the latest IASP classification (radiculopathy, radicular pain, and somatic referred pain); use it to standardize terminology within your practice and improve consistency in care.

items.title: Safety of Early Rehabilitation Dose After Stroke on Composite Outcomes: Analysis of Nationwide Japanese Medical Claims Data.
items.summary: This study, using nationwide Japanese medical claims data (2018-2022), found that early in-hospital rehabilitation (20-60 min/day, initiated on days 1 or 2) after stroke is safe for composite outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后早期康复的剂量与安全性一直是我们关心的。这项大规模观察研究提示，入院后1-2天内开始、每天20-60分钟的康复是安全的，这能让你在临床实践中更放心地推进早期适度康复。
items.titleZh: 卒中后早期康复剂量对复合结局的安全影响：日本全国医疗索赔数据分析
items.summaryZh: 这项利用日本全国医疗索赔数据（2018-2022）的研究发现，卒中后早期住院康复（每日 20-60 分钟，在入院第 1 或第 2 天开始）对复合结局是安全的。
items.curatedReasonEn: The dose and safety of early post-stroke rehabilitation are persistent concerns. This large-scale observational study suggests that rehabilitation initiated within 1-2 days of admission, for 20-60 minutes/day, is safe. This finding should empower you to more confidently advance early, moderate-dose rehabilitation in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 该研究基于医疗索赔数据，可能存在混杂因素和信息偏差，且结果主要适用于日本医疗体系。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on medical claims data, which may have confounding factors and information bias, and the results are primarily applicable to the Japanese healthcare system.

items.title: Advancing spine connectomics and neural integration through machine learning and neuroengineering: a narrative review.
items.summary: This narrative review summarizes advances in spinal connectomics and neuroengineering, highlighting the spinal cord's role in sensorimotor integration and adaptive motor control, driven by machine learning and advanced imaging.
items.curatedReason: 了解脊髓连接组学（spine connectomics）的最新进展，有助于你更好地理解脊髓在感觉运动整合和适应性运动控制中的复杂作用。这篇综述为你在处理复杂脊柱损伤或神经功能障碍时，提供了更深层的理论依据。
items.titleZh: 通过机器学习和神经工程学推进脊髓连接组学和神经整合：一篇叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述总结了脊髓连接组学和神经工程学的进展，强调了在机器学习和先进成像的推动下，脊髓在感觉运动整合和适应性运动控制中的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding the latest advancements in spine connectomics will help you better grasp the complex role of the spinal cord in sensorimotor integration and adaptive motor control. This review provides deeper theoretical grounds for managing complex spinal injuries or neurological dysfunctions.
items.limitation: 本综述为叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未进行系统性证据评估。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may have selection bias and does not involve systematic evidence appraisal.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Factors Explaining Limited Daily Hand-use in Individuals with Fair-Good Motor Ability Post-Stroke.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study identified that beyond motor impairment, factors such as proprioception, executive functions, and self-efficacy explain limited daily hand-use in post-stroke individuals with fair-to-good motor ability.
items.curatedReason: 即使卒中患者上肢运动能力良好，日常手功能使用受限依然常见。这项研究提示，除了运动障碍，本体感觉、执行功能和自我效能等非运动因素也是重要影响因素。你在评估和干预时，需要把这些因素考虑在内。
items.titleZh: 解释卒中后运动能力良好个体日常手部使用受限的因素
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究发现，除了运动障碍，本体感觉、执行功能和自我效能等因素也解释了卒中后运动能力良好个体日常手部使用受限的原因。
items.curatedReasonEn: Even with good upper extremity motor ability, limited daily hand use is common in stroke patients. This study suggests that non-motor factors like proprioception, executive functions, and self-efficacy are significant influences beyond motor impairment. You need to consider these factors in your assessments and interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法确立所评估因素与日常手功能使用限制的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish a causal relationship between the assessed factors and limited daily hand use.

items.title: Lifestyle medicine innovations: Physical activity assessment in patient care and implementation of a digital health platform to support healthier movement.
items.summary: This narrative review introduces the ExerciseRxTM digital health platform as a scalable approach to integrate personalized physical activity and home exercise into clinical care, utilizing the Physical Activity Vital Sign (PAVS) within an academic healthcare system.
items.curatedReason: 数字健康平台正在成为支持患者进行个性化身体活动和居家锻炼的新趋势。了解 ExerciseRxTM 平台如何将“身体活动生命体征”整合进电子病历，能让你思考未来如何在临床实践中利用数字化工具促进患者依从性。
items.titleZh: 生活方式医学创新：患者护理中的身体活动评估及数字健康平台在支持更健康运动中的实施
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述介绍了 ExerciseRxTM 数字健康平台，它作为一种可扩展的方法，将个性化身体活动和居家锻炼整合到临床护理中，并在学术医疗系统中利用身体活动生命体征（PAVS）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Digital health platforms are emerging as a new trend to support personalized physical activity and home exercise for patients. Understanding how the ExerciseRxTM platform integrates "Physical Activity Vital Signs" into electronic health records can help you consider how to leverage digital tools in clinical practice to promote patient adherence in the future.
items.limitation: 本评论为叙述性综述，主要介绍平台概念和应用，缺乏客观的疗效评估和临床数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, primarily introducing the platform concept and its applications, lacking objective efficacy evaluation and clinical data.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: 河南省人民政府办公厅关于印发河南省建立长期护理保险制度实施方案的通知-健康界
items.summary: Henan Province, China, issued an implementation plan for establishing a long-term care insurance system, aiming to fully establish the system across the province within about three years to cover employees, retirees, flexible workers, and unemployed urban and rural residents.
items.curatedReason: 河南省出台长期护理保险制度实施方案，标志着中国在长期护理保障方面迈出了重要一步。如果你在中国执业或关注中国市场，你需要了解这项政策对物理治疗服务，特别是老年康复和居家康复报销的潜在影响。
items.titleZh: 河南省人民政府办公厅关于印发河南省建立长期护理保险制度实施方案的通知
items.summaryZh: 中国河南省人民政府办公厅印发了《河南省建立长期护理保险制度实施方案》，目标在三年内全面建立长期护理保险制度，覆盖就业人员、退休人员、灵活就业人员和未就业城乡居民。
items.curatedReasonEn: Henan Province's implementation plan for long-term care insurance marks a significant step for China in long-term care provision. If you practice in China or follow the Chinese market, you need to understand this policy's potential impact on physical therapy services, especially for geriatric and home-based rehabilitation reimbursement.

items.title: Peri-Fracture Injections Reduce Early Postoperative Pain and Opioid Use, Suggests Study
items.summary: A meta-analysis of RCTs suggests that peri-fracture site injections for distal radius and ankle fractures provide significant pain relief primarily during the early postoperative period and reduce overall opioid consumption.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃分析提示，骨折周围注射在早期术后镇痛和减少阿片类药物使用方面有显著效果。考虑将其作为腕骨和踝骨骨折患者围手术期管理的一部分。
items.titleZh: 研究表明骨折周围注射可减轻术后早期疼痛并减少阿片类药物使用
items.summaryZh: 一项对随机对照试验的荟萃分析发现，腕骨和踝骨骨折患者的骨折周围注射在术后早期显著缓解疼痛，并减少了阿片类药物的总消耗量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis suggests that peri-fracture injections are significantly effective for early postoperative pain relief and opioid reduction. Consider incorporating this approach into perioperative management for patients with distal radius and ankle fractures.
items.limitation: 需进一步研究以确定最佳注射方案和更持久的镇痛效果。
items.limitationEn: Further research is needed to determine optimal injection protocols and longer-lasting analgesia.

items.title: STEPS Rehabilitation among the first in Europe to introduce ARC-EX technology
items.summary: STEPS Rehabilitation in Sheffield, UK, is among the first in Europe to introduce ONWARD Medical's ARC-EX System, a technology designed to support arm and hand function recovery in individuals with incomplete spinal cord injury, approved for use in late 2025.
items.curatedReason: 英国 STEPS Rehabilitation 引进 ARC-EX 系统，标志着脊髓损伤神经康复技术的新进展。关注这类技术，有助于你了解未来辅助手臂和手功能恢复的临床工具。
items.titleZh: STEPS Rehabilitation 率先在欧洲引入 ARC-EX 技术——脊柱外科新闻
items.summaryZh: 英国谢菲尔德的 STEPS Rehabilitation 率先在欧洲引入 ONWARD Medical 的 ARC-EX 系统，该技术旨在支持不完全脊髓损伤患者的手臂和手功能恢复，并已于 2025 年底获批使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: STEPS Rehabilitation in the UK adopting the ARC-EX System marks a new advancement in spinal cord injury neurorehabilitation technology. Monitoring such technologies helps you stay informed about future clinical tools for assisting arm and hand function recovery.

items.title: Why Healthcare RCM Is Still Broken and What Comes Next
items.summary: This webinar from WebPT addresses the ongoing challenges in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) for rehab therapy, exploring current issues and future solutions.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 的这则网络研讨会广告聚焦于医疗收入周期管理（RCM）的痛点和未来解决方案。它提醒你作为物理治疗诊所管理者，持续关注报销和运营效率，尤其是 AI 等新技术的应用。
items.titleZh: 为什么医疗收入周期管理仍然存在问题以及接下来会发生什么
items.summaryZh: WebPT 的这场网络研讨会聚焦于康复治疗领域医疗收入周期管理（RCM）的持续挑战，探讨了当前存在的问题及未来的解决方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This WebPT webinar ad focuses on the pain points and future solutions in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM). It reminds you, as a physical therapy clinic manager, to continuously monitor reimbursement and operational efficiency, especially the application of new technologies like AI.
